programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Le roi des Moonsliders offre un fragment de miroir au vainqueur du concours de danse. Marcus, trac au rendez-vous, affronte Vipkrad et ses robots. Puis, pour conquérir la princesse Youpla et son fragment, Marcus est tétanisé, incapable d'agir. Gratrok prend sa place, mais sans être impressionné par Youpla… Marcus doute alors de son allié.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon parie avec Pétunia de ne pas faire de bêtises jusqu'au coucher du soleil, mais Bagou lui tend des pièges. Poussé à bout, il goûte un gâteau interdit et invente une crise de somnambulisme. Lors d'un quiz, il devient super intelligent grâce à un champignon, mais sa vanité inquiète Pétunia. Fatigué, il fabrique un radeau, espérant convaincre Bagou de l'aider.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Sherlock arbitre une course au zoo où le Guépard, favori, est empoisonné et finit dernier. Suspects : Gazelle, Lion ou Tigre ? Sherlock enquête, mais faire du sport l'épuise tellement qu'il termine en fauteuil roulant. Ensuite, le Chef Panda retrouve sa cuisine détruite. Qui est responsable ? Mr Hippo ou Raton Liveur ? Sherlock prétend tenir la faim grâce à son entraînement shaolin.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Pétunia malade, Grabouillon et Bagou veulent lui rendre visite, mais Cunégonde veille. Ils préparent une mission de sauvetage. Bagou perd la mémoire après une chute, et Grabouillon cherche à le guérir. Après une dispute, Pétunia et Basile se fâchent, tandis que Grabouillon défie les enfants avec des épreuves... qu'ils gagnent !

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Pour un fragment de miroir, Marcus participe aux jeux des Bongos, où la rivalité monte entre lui, Ephi, Gratrok et Loumie. Leur amitié tiendra-t-elle ? Plus tard, ils cherchent le fragment au cœur de la forêt Namou. Marcus adopte un chaton semblable à Maurice, mais ce sont en fait des créatures maléfiques au service de Vipkrad. Marcus devra-t-il s'en séparer ?

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon participe au concours de pizza, triche et complique la vie de ses amis, mais ça pourrait se retourner contre lui. En l'absence de Pétunia, il vide le réservoir d'eau et tente de le remplir avant son retour. Il prête sa voiture cassée à Bagou, qui la répare et refuse de la rendre. Avec des lunettes magiques, Grabouillon croit devenir un géant, mais c'est compliqué.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Ara ne peut pas animer sa radio à cause d'une allergie. Coupable : Mainate, Mme Hippo ou Lynx ? Hermine a le hoquet et cherche un remède. La guitare du vampire, qui dérange la nuit, est sabotée. Qui est responsable ? Pendant ce temps, Hermine doute du romantisme de Sherlock et tente de le toucher.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: La maîtresse montre à Lulu une sculpture faite d'objets assemblés et propose de créer une œuvre collective. Les idées fusent, entre sérieux et absurdité, jusqu'à ce que Lulu trouve l'inspiration. Pendant ce temps, les amis cherchent un cadeau pour Brico, qui préfère réparer son coucou suisse tranquillement.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon met un piment dans sa trottinette et fonce trop vite. Ses amis lui lancent un défi : une course autour de l'île, sinon il perd sa trottinette. Gonzague organise un concours d'abris pour oiseaux. Grabouillon, mauvais bricoleur, se fait aider en secret. Jaloux d'Anowak, il hésite à plonger du haut d'un rocher.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Carmélito libère un génie de lampe, mais gaspille deux vœux dans ses disputes. Le génie disparaît avant le dernier souhait, mais Carmen le retrouve avec un festin. Pendant ce temps, Cokpapy se dispute avec sa sœur Roussie, venue garder le poulailler. Enlevée par Coléra, elle est sauvée grâce à sa cornemuse. Réconciliés, frère et sœur retrouvent leur complicité d'enfance.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Les enfants tentent de faire naître une amitié entre Brico et Qui-Sait-Tout...Comment savoir qui est son meilleur ami ? En écoutant son coeur...

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon et Bagou mangent le banquet d'Anowak, prévu pour la lune ! Ils tentent vite de le reconstituer. Grabouillon casse un vase, essaie de le remplacer, sans succès. Il fait une fausse carte au trésor, Bagou trouve un vrai trésor, Pétunia intervient. Pour éviter Cunégonde, Grabouillon dit oui à tout, mais elle s'installe à côté !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Guillaume Tell vise la pomme sur la tête de son fils, mais Coda s'interpose pour détourner les flèches. En Australie, affamé, il apprend à lancer un boomerang et découvre la faune locale. En espion, Coda doit protéger une machine convoitée par des agents secrets. À Venise, il lutte contre la montée des eaux et tente de sauver les passants distraits.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: La Pieuvre, surmenée au resto de Chef Panda, se fait saboter ses tentacules. Qui ? Éléphant, Vampire ou Autruche ? Sherlock prétend ne jamais être surpris, mais Hermine veut lui prouver le contraire. Le Mainate subit un chantage pour récupérer son carnet de blagues. Qui est derrière ? Orang-outan, Gorfou ou Mouffette ? Sherlock s'obsède sur un jeu mystique.

programme.title: Un petit ami très envahissant
programme.desc: Sam se trouve un petit ami, et ces deux là sont inséparables. Mais quand leur relation se met à interférer avec iCarly, Carly et Freddie savent qu'ils doivent intervenir.

programme.title: Les videos pirates
programme.desc: Après avoir regardé un extrait d'iCarly qui montre un homme vendre des copies illégales de films, deux détectives décident de se servir de Carly et Spencer pour leur enquête.

programme.title: En route pour luniversité
programme.desc: Carly apprend que son émission lui ouvre les portes d'une scolarité dans une école privée très cotée. Carly doute encore, mais Sam et Freddie savent qu'ils n'ont pas envie de la voir partir...

programme.title: Adversaires
programme.desc: Freddie part faire de l'escrime avec Spencer. Il s'en sort bien, mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Spencer se retrouve impliqué dans un match avec l'incroyable Doug Toder.

programme.title: Je gagne un rencard
programme.desc: Gibby est trop timide pour demander à la fille qui lui plait de sortir avec lui, le groupe décide alors d'organiser une tranche "je gagne un rendez-vous" sur leur émission.

programme.title: Ma prof est folle
programme.desc: Madame Ackerman, le professeur du groupe, est en pleine rupture avec son petit-ami, ce qui la rend aigrie avec ses étudiants. Une visite de Spencer pour arranger les choses se transforme en rendez-vous.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: Je lai vu la première
programme.desc: Carly et Sam s'intéressent au même garçon, mais elles se jurent qu'il ne sèmera pas la zizanie entre elles. Malheureusement, les choses ne se déroulent pas si facilement et elles finissent par entrer en compétition.

programme.title: Pak-Rat
programme.desc: Spencer devient accro à un jeu-vidéo et Carly doit intervenir. De son côté, Sam fait croire à Freddie qu'il est maudit pour avoir refusé de transmettre une lettre chaîne.

programme.title: Pour une poignée de dollars
programme.desc: Sam se sent insultée quand Freddie l'accuse de ne pas rembourser l'argent qu'elle emprunte. Du coup elle va tout faire pour effacer ses dettes. Voyant le travail qu'elle fournit, Sam et Carly décident de l'aider secrètement.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Cest pas de la tarte
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Spencer emmènent Freddie dans leur boutique de tartes préférée. A leur arrivée, ils apprennent que le propriétaire a disparu en emportant la recette des tartes avec lui.

programme.title: Spencer est normal
programme.desc: Alors qu'il souhaite pimenter un peu la tradition de Noël avec un arbre peu conventionnel, Spencer met accidentellement le feu aux cadeaux de Carly. Bouleversée, elle rêve d'avoir un frère normal.

programme.title: Le premier baiser
programme.desc: Alors que Freddie confie à Carly qu'il n'a jamais embrassé une fille, Sam surprend leur conversation et dévoile le secret de Freddie sur Internet.

programme.title: 2025 : Armageddon
programme.desc: Une race extraterrestre militante lance une attaque sur la Terre.

programme.title: Earthquake Underground
programme.desc: Après qu'un tremblement de terre massif ait enseveli un hôtel, un jeune architecte tente de sauver s

programme.title: Creuser pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un père et sa fille sourde sont forcés par des criminels de creuser sous une maison abandonnée.

programme.title: Doomsday Meteor
programme.desc: Un météore géant menace la Terre : une mission spatiale est envoyée pour le détourner, mais tout tourne mal.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Six inconnus piégés dans un champ de maïs doivent s'unir pour échapper à une mystérieuse menace.

programme.title: Au Secours ! J'ai rétréci mes amis
programme.desc: Pour protéger ses objets magiques, Otto Leonhard a enseigné à Félix l'art secret du rétrécissement. Ses amis ayant failli gâcher son rendez-vous avec Mélanie, Félix les réduit instantanément à un dixième de leur taille.

programme.title: Dreams
programme.desc: A partir de 6 ans Emma est une jeune fille qui partage sa chambre avec Coco son cochon d'Inde. Une nuit, dans son sommeil, elle bascule dans un monde merveilleux. Elle découvre alors qu'elle a le pouvoir d'entrer dans le monde des rêves et de changer le futur.

programme.title: Monstre sur Commande
programme.desc: Une jeune adolescente chahutée par ses camarades de classe commande sur Internet les pièces détachées d'un "monstre" qui figure dans une bande dessinée. Elle va enfin pouvoir se venger de ceux qui la tourmentent !

programme.title: Mission Trésor
programme.desc: Julka, 12 ans, n'a encore jamais eu de véritable ami. Au lieu de suivre ses parents au Canada, Julka va devoir passer ses vacances chez sa tante à Varsovie. Elle rencontre alors Olek qui vit dans le même bâtiment.

programme.title: Zip & Zap
programme.desc: Zip et Zap, deux jumeaux très turbulents, toujours prêts à faire les quatre cents coups, sont punis et envoyés dans un camp d'été très particulier.

programme.title: Gallow Walkers
programme.desc: Après avoir renié Dieu, un cow-boy nommé Kaos, se voit infliger une malédiction qui ramène à la vie tous ceux qu'il a tués et qu'il tuera. Très vite, une armée de victimes menée par Kansa, revient du monde des morts et se lance à sa poursuite. Afin d'équilibrer le combat, Kaos engage un jeune guerrier, Fabulos, pour se battre à ses côtés.

programme.title: Survive
programme.desc: Jane et Paul sont les seuls rescapés d'un crash d'avion sur une montagne enneigée. Ils vont devoir se battre contre les éléments au péril de leur vie pour regagner la civilisation.

programme.title: Cartel Escape
programme.desc: Carla, une jeune mexicaine, se retrouve par accident aux États-Unis après avoir traversé un tunnel abandonné. Au cœur du désert de Yucca Valley, elle se retrouve alors prise dans un jeu mortel du chat et de la souris entre la CIA, le cartel et des informateurs du gouvernement.

programme.title: Baja
programme.desc: En cavale après une sale affaire de drogue, Bebe et Alex fuient à Baja au Mexique, où les attendent de faux passeports. Mais le père de Bebe charge Michael, son ex-mari, de la ramener aux États-Unis, quitte à supprimer Alex. Un tueur de la mafia est également à leurs trousses...

programme.title: Cops Incrimination
programme.desc: Deux policiers arrêtent une voiture et tuent le conducteur, un jeune afro-américain qu'ils croyaient armé. Le père de la victime, un juge, décide de prendre la justice entre ses mains lorsque les deux policiers sont innocentés.

programme.title: La guerre de l'ombre
programme.desc: En 1980, à Belfast, Martin McGartland, 22 ans, doit choisir entre l'IRA et les services secrets britanniques. Il opte pour les Anglais malgré le danger.

programme.title: 5 est le numéro parfait
programme.desc: Un an après avoir surpassé le FBI, les 4 Cavaliers reviennent pour dénoncer un magnat criminel. Ignorant son piège, ils doivent braquer un système informatique sécurisé.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: Un photographe est chargé d'escorter une jeune femme à travers une zone dévastée et peuplée de créatures monstrueuses

programme.title: Speed driver
programme.desc: Eun-ha utilise ses talents de conductrice hors pair dans son métier de livreuse spécialisée dans le transport de criminels et de fugitifs. Un jour, une de ses missions tourne mal.

programme.title: Mort ou fisc
programme.desc: André Boulet, chef d'entreprise dans le secteur de la démolition, souffre d'une grave maladie hallucinatoire. Apprenant que son entreprise va subir un contrôle fiscal, il est pris de panique et décide d'éliminer l'argent du fisc en charge du dossier.

programme.title: Océan
programme.desc: A travers le regard de Jean, un enfant d'une petite dizaine d'années, nous partageons le quotidien d'une famille en vacances à l'océan, à la fin des années 70. Cet été là, Jean réalise que son père et sa mère ne s'aiment plus.

programme.title: Marzevan
programme.desc: Aux derniers jours de sa vie, une vieille dame à la mémoire troublée entrevoit l'histoire de ses origines. Commence alors un voyage vers la terre ancestrale, où les souvenirs et l'imagination s'organisent peu à peu.

programme.title: La bifle
programme.desc: Francis est le patron d'un vidéoclub qui doit son succès aux films de Ti-Kong, star de kung-fu et briseur de nuques. Complexé par la taille de son sexe, Francis n'arrive pas à avouer ses sentiments à Sonia, son employée. Mais lorsqu'elle se voit offrir un rôle dans Evil Nurse, dernier opus de Ti-Kong, Francis n'a plus le choix. Il va devoir regagner sa confiance sexuelle pour sauver Sonia d'un terrible danger : La Bifle.

programme.title: Quelques secondes
programme.desc: Le quotidien de 5 jeunes filles qui vivent dans un Centre d'Hebergement et de Réinsertion Sociale de Paris. Toutes hantées par un passé chargé (viol, abandon, violences), elles tentent d'avancer et préfèrent voir le verre à moitié à plein. Toutes sauf Sam.

programme.title: Meninas Formicida
programme.desc: Dans une petite ville du Brésil, une adolescente passe ses journées à travailler dans une forêt d'eucalyptus où elle chasse des fourmis parasites à l'aide de pesticides. Mais son véritable combat est intérieur.

programme.title: Je criais contre la vie, ou pour elle
programme.desc: Dans une forêt, un troupeau de cerfs se retourne contre la meute de chiens qui le poursuivait jusque là. De cette étrange course naissent des paysages s'élevant du sol.

programme.title: Trois petits points
programme.desc: Une petite couturière attend son mari parti à la guerre.

programme.title: Rhapsodie pour un pot-au-feu
programme.desc: Trois générations d'une même famille cohabitent sous le même toit dans une chorégraphie désaccordée. La mère, chef d'orchestre de la famille, tente en vain de les réunir à table pour le dîner.

programme.title: Floating in my mind
programme.desc: Un film qui raconte l'histoire de la vie, de rencontres, de souvenirs...

programme.title: Le dernier jour d'un condamné
programme.desc: Camille, une jeune lycéenne, est en pleines révisions. Lassée par son travail, Camille jette un œil dans le frigidaire et y trouve un homard vivant. Se prenant d'affection pour l'animal, l'adolescente décide de lui faire vivre les plus belles heures de son existence...

programme.title: A Shadow of blue
programme.desc: Un soir d'automne, dans un parc situé au milieu d'une ville morne, une petite fille assise sur un banc, nous fait partager plusieurs visions d'une même réalité.

programme.title: Totems
programme.desc: Un bûcheron travaille dans la forêt quand un arbre s'écrase sur lui et l'immobilise. La détresse réveille alors l'animal caché en lui…

programme.title: Pim Poum le petit Panda
programme.desc: Pour Daniel, Pim-Poum le panda c'est presque le rôle de sa vie. Presque, parce que dans le fond ce qui l'intéresse c'est d'être payé. En compagnie de Lucie et Caro, et sous la direction de Marie-Agnès, ils vont se présenter devant leur public : un groupe d'enfants de 5 ans. Alors que la représentation aurait pu bien se dérouler, les interêts de chacun, l'interprétation des personnages et la mise en scène font virer le spectacle au désastre.

programme.title: Le distributeur d'aurores boréales
programme.desc: Lola collectionne les horloges cassées depuis qu'elle a perdu sa mère. Une nuit, elle découvre que l'une d'elle est hantée... Peut-on tomber amoureux d'un fantôme? Que se passerait-il s'il revenait dans la réalité ?

programme.title: Regards libres
programme.desc: Des enfants observent, commentent et critiquent un tableau.

programme.title: Tomatl, chronique de la fin d'un monde
programme.desc: La tomate fut découverte par les européens en même temps que le Nouveau Monde. Les Aztèques léguèrent cette plante, qui couvre aujourd'hui le tiers des surfaces de la planète...

programme.title: Kroak
programme.desc: Kroak part pêcher tôt le matin. De son baluchon, il sort tout une panoplie d'outils et attend le poisson qui ne vient pas. Lorsque ça mord enfin, c'est un refrigérateur qui sort de l'eau, puis une table dressée et enfin un drôle de poisson.

programme.title: Personne ne s'aimera jamais comme on s'aime
programme.desc: Pauline et Noham s'aiment à la folie. Quand la mère de Pauline lui annonce qu'elles déménagent à Paris, Pauline, incapable de se séparer de Noham, décide de rester vivre dans sa ville natale. Seulement voilà, Pauline n'a que dix ans…

programme.title: Le bûcheron des mots
programme.desc: Dans un pays où les habitants se nourrissent, au sens propre, de lettres et de mots cueillis dans les arbres, la lecture est vitale s'ils ne veulent pas mourir... d'ennui. Mais certains livres sont interdits à cause de leur contenu émotionnel et des transformations physiques qu'ils provoquent. Nadal, un bûcheron des mots, fait une rencontre qui change définitivement sa vie...

programme.title: Circuit marine
programme.desc: Un bateau en haute mer, les marins pêchent, mangent, boivent...et chantent. Le chat regarde le perroquet, le perroquet regarde le joli poisson dans son bocal, le chat regarde le poisson... Qui mangera qui ?

programme.title: La grande migration
programme.desc: Les aventures humoristiques d'un oiseau migrateur qui perd ses congénères dans les nuages...

programme.title: Una furtiva lagrima
programme.desc: Ultime voyage d'un poisson qui chante son propre requiem, depuis la vente à la poissonnerie jusque dans la poêle à frire.

programme.title: Bang Bang !
programme.desc: Bang ! Bang ! C'est l'ouverture de la chasse. Et aussi l'anniversaire d'Éda : vingt-cinq ans. Pour fêter ça, son père lui offre un appartement qui vient d'être saisi. Happy Birthday ! Éda fuit. Elle roule vite, trop vite. Quand un chien rose surgit dans ses phares, c'est l'accident. Effrayée par l'étrange animal, elle s'engouffre dans la forêt où son père mène la chasse…

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Robin se fait larguer par sa copine, Annie, parce qu'il n'arrive pas à lui exprimer ses sentiments. Aidé de son chien, il va tout faire pour la récupérer.

programme.title: Mortal break-up inferno
programme.desc: La traque infernale d'un jeune homme par sa copine qui n'a pas digéré leur rupture.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: La semaine des 4 jeudis
programme.desc: Marc a rencontré une fille qui lui a tapé dans l'oeil. Leur histoire va être d'autant plus compliquée que la semaine des quatre jeudis commence aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Fugazi
programme.desc: 2039 : depuis plus de 3 ans, Adèle travaille pour Orbit Defence, une station spatiale chargée du pilotage de drones sur la planète Terre. Aujourd'hui, tenant entre ses mains des joysticks, il ne lui reste plus qu'une mission de routine à accomplir avant de rejoindre enfin sa famille.

programme.title: A l'ombre du voile
programme.desc: Deux femmes musulmanes, une mère et sa fille, se rendent à une manifestation contre l'interdiction du voile à l'école. De retour à la maison, la mère invite sa fille à abandonner ce voile à travers une danse désespérée et troublante.

programme.title: Assaut sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim est un New-Yorkais ordinaire menant une vie paisible avec un emploi bien rémunéré et une famille aimante. Soudain, tout bascule lorsque l'économie s'effondre, faisant perdre à Jim tout ce qu'il avait. Rempli de colère et de rage, Jim craque et va jusqu'à l'extrême pour se venger de la vie qu'on lui a arrachée.

programme.title: La Division
programme.desc: Dans les années 90, Rio de Janeiro a été secouée par une vague d'enlèvements. Les forces de sécurité font appel à des agents controversés pour aider à sauver la ville des criminels, mais aussi de la police elle-même.

programme.title: Le Dernier Tueur à Gage
programme.desc: Harry, un tueur à gages vieillissant, vient de faire échouer une mission et est maintenant la cible. Sa fille, qui travaille également comme tueuse à gages, est elle aussi prise pour cible. Un jeune tueur à gages, Billy, est envoyé pour éliminer Harry, mais ils forment une alliance difficile...

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: Our guys : outrage in Glen Ridge
programme.desc: Une détective chevronnée revient dans sa ville natale pour enquêter sur le cas choquant du viol d'une jeune fille handicapée mentale. La ville veut étouffer l'affaire et se montre hostile à l'enquête.

programme.title: Other side of love
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire accepte de garder de l'argent pour un homme, ignorant qu'il s'agit d'un trafiquant. Arrêté, il la désigne comme coupable, la plongeant dans une situation dangereuse.

programme.title: Something About Sex
programme.desc: La monogamie est-elle possible dans le mariage moderne ? Art Witz, un célibataire maladroit, pose cette question lors d'un dîner avec des couples en apparence mariés et heureux, et déclenche une série d'aventures sexuelles cocasses...

programme.title: Alice Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Dans ce conte classique, Alice tombe à travers un miroir et arrive dans un endroit merveilleux appelé le Pays des Merveilles ! Le voyage d'Alice à travers les huit carrés fous du Pays des Merveilles est présenté à l'écran dans un film d'animation de haute qualité, divertissant pour vos enfants et votre famille. En chemin, Alice rencontre des amis comme Bonnet blanc, et des ennemis tels que le méchant Jaseroque et le Bandersnatch !

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: Récit d'une romance interdite et de l'évolution des conventions sociales, My Policeman suit les relations entre trois personnes — le policier Tom, l'enseignante Marion et le conservateur de musée Patrick — et leur parcours émotionnel s'étalant sur plusieurs décennies.

programme.title: The Communion Girl
programme.desc: Espagne, fin des années 1980. Sara, nouvelle arrivante, essaie de s'intégrer aux autres adolescents d'une petite ville soudée de la province de Tarrgone.

programme.title: The Samaritan
programme.desc: Après avoir purgé 25 ans de prison pour le meurtre de son partenaire Eddy, Foley est libéré, déterminé à mener une vie honnête. Il trouve un travail et tente d'aller de l'avant, mais le fils vengeur d'Eddy, Ethan, le retrouve et le pousse à participer à une arnaque à haut risque.

programme.title: Une famille sur le ring
programme.desc: L'ancien catcheur Ricky et sa femme Julia vivent de leurs représentations avec leurs enfants, Saraya et Zak. Lorsque le frère et la sœur ont l'opportunité de passer des auditions pour la WWE, ils apprennent que devenir une Superstar WWE est bien plus exigeant qu'ils ne l'auraient imaginé.

programme.title: Mon amour, mon obsession
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de son fiancé, Megan refait sa vie. Mais Lloyd, son ex-collègue obsédé, est prêt à tout.

programme.title: La tentation de mon mari
programme.desc: Sean, rédacteur publicitaire, est embauché par l'agence de ses rêves. Katie, lui confie une jolie assistante.

programme.title: Coup de foudre en livraison
programme.desc: Une animatrice de télévision talentueuse présente un fleuriste local proposant un service de livraison de fleurs le jour même révolutionnaire et un concours de fleurs de longue date pour avoir une chance de décrocher sa propre émission.

programme.title: Noël royal pour la femme de chambre
programme.desc: À Noël, la gouvernante Neve, prise pour une invitée par le prince James, risque son travail et son amour.

programme.title: La plus belle étoile de Noël
programme.desc: Un médecin rentre chez lui pour Noël, trouve son père à la retraite et envisage de rentrer chez lui pour retrouver sa famille et son amour.

programme.title: Docteur T et les femmes
programme.desc: Un gynécologue attractif (Richard Gere), pris dans les tourments d'une crise de la cinquantaine, a autant de difficultés avec sa famille qu'avec sa propre vie. Par chance, il rencontre une femme (Helen Hunt) qui pourrait bien être la solution à ses problèmes.

programme.title: Innocent
programme.desc: Dans cette séquelle du film Présumé innocent de Scott Turow, le juge Rusty Sabich (Pullman) se retrouve à nouveau au centre d'une enquête pour meurtre lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: La talentueuse Mademoiselle Cooper
programme.desc: Un prince, et héritier du trône, se trouve dans une impasse suite à une soirée qui a mal tourné. La famille royale fait donc appel à une excellente responsable en communication pour redorer son image ternie. Alors que la consultante se rend chez le prince, elle tombe malade et demande à son assistante d'y aller à sa place. Cette dernière – à l'insu de sa patronne- excelle dans la création de campagne de relations publiques du prince. Mais quand l'assistante tombe amoureuse de lui et que ses sentiments sont réciproques, elle doit lui révéler la vérité et voir ce qui arrivera quand il saura.

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Un directeur de publicité à succès acquiert la capacité d'entendre les pensées des femmes et utilise cela à son avantage pour progresser au travail et gagner le cœur de son nouveau patron.

programme.title: La valse des pantins
programme.desc: Un comique méconnu, pour se faire reconnaitre, enlève le présentateur d'un show télévisé et n'accepte de le libérer qu'à la condition de participer à son spectacle.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: High Crimes
programme.desc: La vie d'une femme se retrouve impliquée dans une énorme affaire de dissimulation militaire quand elle apprend que son mari n'est pas celui qu'il prétend être.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que le Staying Alive de Tony Manero fait toujours autant fureur. Il se approche maintenant nonchalamment de son plus grand défi : le produire sur la scène de Broadway.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: Close Up

Un groupe de colons, voyageant sur des chariots, a été assassiné par les mormons indigènes. Au total, environ 140 âmes d'hommes, de femmes et d'enfants ont été enlevées.

programme.desc: Lorsque Allison, 14 ans, perd son père dans un accident d'avion, trois ans après la mort de sa mère adoptive, elle est dévastée. Elle et sa demi-sœur Sydni seront encore plus choquées de découvrir que Jessica a un plan infâme pour contrôler les 40 millions de dollars dont Allison doit hériter.

programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

Ne sachant où aller, elle atterrit dans une association d'étudiantes menacées d'expulsion si elles ne parviennent pas à attirer de nouveaux membres. Décidée à les aider, Shelley va utiliser toutes ses ressources de pin-up pour transformer les filles en créatures de rêve et faire de Zeta Alpha Zeta une des associations les plus populaires du campus...

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Jenko et Schmidt quittent le lycée et s'engagent dans la police. A la suite de leur première arrestation ratée, les deux jeunes policiers sont convoqués par leur supérieur. Celui-ci leur annonce qu'ils sont mutés dans une cellule des années 80 récemment réactivée, l'unité «21 Jump Street». Dans une église désaffectée, Jenko et Schmidt rencontrent d'autres jeunes policiers. Tous ont été choisis pour infiltrer les milieux universitaires californiens en tant qu'étudiants. Leur objectif est de démanteler les réseaux de trafiquants de drogue. Ces recrues sont soumises à des règles précises : pas de relations avec les élèves et les enseignants, et pas d'achat d'alcool à leur place. Jenko et Schmidt tente de mener l'enquête, mais n'en font qu'à leur tête...

programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Seasons of the Forest
programme.desc: No place on Earth is more changeable than the seasonal forest, undergoing radical transformations year after year. These adaptations to the seasons are what makes our woodlands so varied and dynamic a cycle of interwoven behaviors and practices ticking away like a Swiss watch to rejuvenate the landscape ready for the new year. To fully understand the stories of the great woodlands spend a year among the trees, watching the energetic and vibrant changes that mark the seasons of the forest.

programme.title: The Magic of the Mangroves
programme.desc: Mangroves are one of the most important habitats on Earth, vital to many of the planet's most extraordinary, wonderful and endangered species. Everything from shorebirds and sharks to monkeys and manatees rely on mangroves. And although we tend to view them as a mess of tangled roots, mosquitoes and mud, they're also crucial for safeguarding the well-being of humans. Once we start explore this unique landscape there's no doubt that we will be just as enchanted as wildlife by the magic of mangroves.

programme.title: Urban Warriors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes.

programme.title: Endagered with Michaela Strachen
programme.desc: Seeks to find the rare and endangered species of South Africa and establish what we need to do to conserve them. Documenting and recording the status of our endangered species by region.

programme.title: The Power of Plants Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation – a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Our ideas about plants need a seed change – it's time to respect the power of plants.

programme.title: Mind of a Giant
programme.desc: What is it like to be an elephant? This series reveals new research which attempts to answer that question.

programme.title: Seasons of the Forest
programme.desc: No place on Earth is more changeable than the seasonal forest, undergoing radical transformations year after year. These adaptations to the seasons are what makes our woodlands so varied and dynamic a cycle of interwoven behaviors and practices ticking away like a Swiss watch to rejuvenate the landscape ready for the new year. programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany's beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country's hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: The Sun
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It's the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it's only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Menorca
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers. With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: The Dream Forge

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Terrible Power
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: All the world's a stage
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. ""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Laundry Day
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi

Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit

Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz

Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is super-talented singer Lydia Lee! Back in 2015 one high school student posted her cover of Adele's smash single “Hello” to YouTube. The video quickly went viral worldwide garnering about 14 million views in just three weeks. It's none other than Lydia Lee. Soon after that she appeared in The Ellen DeGeneres Show as the second Korean after PSY. What's more the American magazine People also chose her rendition as the best cover of Hello. 2 years later in 2017 Lydia Lee released her debut album Blue and in August this year she returned to the music scene with the EP The House That I Live In. In this episode this artist performs Blue Don't Matter Villa Deshayes Grey to Green Farewell John and her cover of Sam Kim's Make Up. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and see once again how she mesmerizes the world!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Kim Sa-wol! This artist made her big debut in 2014 as a member of the folk duo Kim Sawol x Kim Hae Won and enchanted many with the debut mini-album Secret. That year the two won the Best Rookie Artist and the Best Folk Album at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. The next year Kim Sa-wol released her first solo album Suzanne and then the second solo album Romance winning a total of 5 awards at the Korean Music Awards between 2014 and 2018. This past September Kim Sa-wol dropped her third release as a solo artist. Titled Heaven It illustrates her honest stories and feelings including loneliness life's uncertainty frustration and more. Her wispy voice and the bittersweet mood blend well in this new masterpiece. In this episode Kim Sa-wol performs Disposable KEY Fugitive Yellow Signal and Someone to offer an exquisite glimpse into her stunning musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her intimate dreamy music!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are the beloved monkies of the Korean music industry - JANNABI! JANNABI is an old-fashioned Korean word for “monkey” and this band made their debut in 2014 with the digital single Rocket. Since then they have impressed numerous listeners with their retro-infused music that portrays various stories of the youth ranging from love to separation to frustration. Last year the band released their second full-length album Legend and topped all the music charts with the album's lead track for lovers who hesitate. Before releasing their third full-length album next year the band dropped a new mini-album just a week ago and this time as a duo to nourish listeners' hearts. In this episode JANNABI performs both their latest tracks and hit songs - A thought on an autumn night Old dog Sweet memories and Step from their new album JANNABI's Small Pieces 1 as well as Summer and for lovers who hesitate. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy a beautiful autumn day with these talented musicians!

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.
